title: Proprietary delivery platforms decouple revenue expansion from headcount growth
text: Traditional professional services firms suffer from linear economics where revenue growth requires proportional headcount expansion. AI-native services achieve non-linear leverage by channeling delivery through proprietary platforms that capture workflow metadata, edge-case resolutions, and systems of record. As the platform's autonomous completion rate rises, gross margins expand from services levels (30–50%) toward software economics (70%+).
qualification: Venture financial model for tech-enabled services; relies on early portfolio gross margin trajectories and assumes competitive defensibility of proprietary delivery engines.

public_locator.value: Breaking the linear relationship between headcount and revenue... building proprietary software and delivery platforms that improve gross margins toward 70-80% over time.
